description: Source code for a Python script that wraps the clang-tidy linter, manages subprocess calls, parses output, and handles command-line arguments for linting C++ files within a PyTorch project.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of lint message severity levels: error, warning, advice, disabled.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details like path, line, code, severity, and description.

methods.name: scm_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the source control management (SCM) repository (.git or .hg).

methods.name: get_python_include_dir
methods.description: Returns the Python include directory path based on sysconfig.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Runs clang-tidy on a given file, parses output, and returns lint messages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script; parses arguments, manages threading, and outputs lint results.
